name: king_county_address_to_parcel
description: Convert a King County, WA street address to its 10-digit parcel number, with the permitting jurisdiction derived from the city-limits polygon (not the mailing city) and the match quality. Returns action=use (exact match), action=pick (ambiguous — show candidates), action=refine (no match — try different input), or action=reject (bad input). Also verifies a bare parcel number or 'PIN: XXXXXXXXXX' against the official King County parcel layer. Split cities (Milton, Pacific, Auburn) resolve on the Pierce side too, namespaced 'pierce:'. Use this before any tool that requires a King County parcel number.

address.description: Street address in King County, WA. Include house number and street name. City is recommended. Also verifies bare 10-digit parcel numbers. Examples: '1817 Morris Ave S, Renton, WA 98055', '600 Grady Way, Renton', '7222000353'.

action.description: use — parcel_number is valid, consume it; pick — multiple candidates, present to user or pick highest-score; refine — no match found, try a different input; reject — bad input (wrong county, no house number), do not retry

parcel_number.description: 10-digit King County parcel number. Present when action=use or action=pick.

parcel_id.description: County-namespaced id, e.g. 'king:7222000353' or 'pierce:5985002900' (split cities straddle the county line).

jurisdiction.description: The permitting authority: city (null when unincorporated), basis (city-limits = point inside the city's polygon — authoritative; geocoder-city = locator's city), unincorporated. The mailing city is NOT the authority: 'Kent, WA' addresses can be unincorporated King County.

address_resolution.description: Match quality: match_type (point = exact address point; interpolated = number placed along the street; street = street only), partial_match, street_number_snapped (the matched house number differs from the input), parcel_basis (address-point | parcel-polygon | nearby-parcel — the last two mean the PIN came from the parcel layer under/within 40 ft of the point; check candidate_parcels when present).

candidates.description: Ranked alternatives. Every candidate has the same fields; source-specific ranking values are null when unavailable.

house_number_distance.description: Absolute house-number difference for nearby-address fallback results; not a physical distance.

suggestions.description: Hints for the user when action=refine or reject.

exit_codes.1: action=pick or refine — needs user input or a different address
exit_codes.2: action=reject — do not retry without changing input
